comparison.objective: Time a points lever to route a moving train safely; candidate adjusts damping between guarded test cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed lever pulling/pushing based on moving-object state versus powered-off tool adjustment followed by physical control actuation and response observation.
comparison.success_condition: Ball bypasses obstruction and rejoins safely, with zero for junction switching versus two bounded, non-bottoming cycles and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Both couple manipulation to dynamic motion, but one tests timing a discrete route switch while the other tests iterative parameter calibration. Lever scoring is explicit; no separate specs exist.
